title: Eight queens
description:
Place queens on a board so none attack each other, with backtracking.

```
8 queens: 92 solutions
first:
Q.......
....Q...
.......Q
.....Q..
..Q.....
......Q.
.Q......
...Q....
```
hints: The two diagonals of square (r, c) are `r + c` and `r - c + n - 1` (lesson 6.05).
Place, recurse, then remove the queen again: that undo step is the "back" in backtracking.
requirements: Place one queen per row; for each column, check the column and both diagonals.
Count all solutions for n = 4 to 8 and print the first one for 8.
Keep three `std::vector<bool>` for the used columns and diagonals.
stretch: Solve a Sudoku with the same pattern.
